leadText: Theodore (Japanese: タクゾウ Takuzo) is a character of the day who appeared in To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!. He made it to the finals of the Pokémon Ping Pong Tournament with his and lost against O and his . He did not have a speaking role in the episode and never appeared in person, but his face appeared on the screen showing the finalists.
